title: Big Chill — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Big Chill.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Retro Reimagined." Premium tier. Big Chill makes full-size retro-styled appliances in 8+ standard colors plus custom options — manufactured in the USA. Their Classic and Pro lines bring mid-century modern charm to modern kitchens. The only real competitor to Smeg in the retro segment, but at full American appliance sizes.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Retro kitchen designs, mid-century modern renovations, customers who want a colorful kitchen statement.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Big Chill:

• Full-size retro appliances — not compact like Smeg

• 8+ standard colors plus custom Pantone matching

• American-made — assembled in the USA

• Only full-size competitor to Smeg in the retro segment

• Modern performance inside vintage-inspired design
